commits.message:
Bump oxalis-libs.version from 4.2.1 to 4.4.0 (#494) Bumps `oxalis-libs.version` from 4.2.1 to 4.4.0. Updates `network.oxalis.vefa:peppol-lookup` from 4.2.1 to 4.4.0
Release notes

Sourced from network.oxalis.vefa:peppol-lookup's releases.

4.4.0

✨ Enhancements

  • Added support for OpenPeppol eDEC Code Lists v9.6
  • Introduced full read/write support for Peppol Message Level Status (MLS)

🛠️ Changes

  • Dropped support for Peppol G2 PKI
  • Updated test cases to align with recent lookup changes
  • Bumped dependency versions: commons-certvalidator and Jakarta Mail

Full Changelog: https://github.com/OxalisCommunity/vefa-peppol/compare/v4.3.0...v4.4.0

4.4.0-RC1

✨ Enhancements

  • Added support for OpenPeppol eDEC Code Lists v9.6
  • Introduced read/write support for Peppol Message Level Status (MLS)

🛠️ Changes

  • Removed support for Peppol G2 PKI
  • Updated and adjusted failing test cases to align with recent lookup changes

Full Changelog: https://github.com/OxalisCommunity/vefa-peppol/compare/v4.3.0...v4.4.0-RC1

4.3.0

  • OpenPeppol eDEC Code Lists: Added support for OpenPeppol eDEC Code Lists v9.5
  • TICC-174: Replace string equality with semantic DN comparison
  • Relax validation to allow non-Peppol document type identifier with warning
  • Fixed failing test-cases due to invalid/outdated period in test-files

Full Changelog: https://github.com/OxalisCommunity/vefa-peppol/compare/v4.2.1...v4.3.0

4.2.2

This tag release introduces explicit handling for "BEAst document profiles". BEAst profiles that currently do not conform to OpenPeppol eDEC code lists are supported with a warning and are treated as non-Peppol document types.
